item.title: Herdr Notch 2.0.3
item.description:
Added

  • A Codex home can opt out of the footer. An empty .herdr-notch-ignore file in a home drops its usage line. The ChatGPT app keeps ~/.codex signed in whether or not a launcher uses it.

item.title: Herdr Notch 2.0.2
item.description:
Changed

  • Usage lines carry no machine tag. Most lines are fed by a peer, so the tags crowded the footer. Rows keep theirs.

item.title: Herdr Notch 2.0.1
item.description:
Fixed

  • A Done seen in the Herdr app keeps its full 4 s flash. The app marks a finish seen as soon as its tab is on screen, which cut the flash to about half a second, or nothing.

item.title: Herdr Notch 2.0.0
item.description:
Added

  • Macs share through herdr-core. Each notch keeps a herdr-notch document on its own herdr-core — this Mac's usage readings, its rows' context percentages and its sessions — and reads the same document from every connected machine in the core's machine.list. Nothing to configure in the notch; a machine removed there leaves the notch.
  • Context bars on remote rows. Remote Herdr app spaces and loose hc agents get bars when that machine runs Notch 2.
  • Usage lines follow the account. Each footer line shows the freshest reading of its account from any connected machine, tagged with that machine. An account only another machine has gets its own tagged line: offline without a reading, gone once no machine that had it is listed. Accounts cross machines only as hashes; no token leaves its Mac.
  • History covers every machine. A line's popup sums the sessions on its account from every connected machine, and each session records the row it ran in.
  • Machine hint. A connected machine with rows but no live Notch 2 document adds the grey line <machine> · no Notch 2 running.

Changed

  • Update feed appcast-v2.xml. 2.x checks its own feed; 1.x stays on appcast.xml and is never offered 2.x.
  • Row marks. Loose hc agents, local or remote, get a filled pane square, so every row has a mark. App spaces keep the four-square.
  • Notices. looking for Herdr, no agents and start Herdr replace looking for herdr, no workspaces and start herdr.

Removed

  • herdr TUI support. The notch no longer reads the TUI's socket: no TUI rows, dashed-square mark or TUI notices (lost herdr, herdr protocol N). The TUI stays on 1.x.
  • hdr and hdrm, the ssh forwards they opened, the usage.sock publisher and the footer's followed-host cell. The notch binds no socket and starts no ssh.
  • iTerm2 activation and the Apple Events entitlement. Every row click goes to the Herdr app; no Automation prompt.

Upgrading

  • Install 2.0.0 by hand once per Mac, from its DMG: 1.x never offers it. Auto-update works from then on.
  • Each Mac's herdr-core must add the other for two-way data: hc machine add <ssh target> --name <name> on both. A core reads only machines it added itself.
  • Rollback: install the 1.5.9 DMG; it follows appcast.xml, settings and history intact.
